result.instructions: Tools for FinerWorks, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my FinerWorks orders are still in production?"; "Show the status of order PO 1042."; "How much would 3 prints of SKU AP6543P49875 cost, shipped to Austin, TX?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FinerWorks data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run finerworks_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run finerworks_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run finerworks_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. finerworks_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: finerworks_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The FinerWorks account these API keys belong to: username, email, billing and business addresses, account credits, shipping preferences and app details. The API keys, payment profile and third-party connection secrets are never returned. GET /v3/test_my_credentials.

tools.name: finerworks_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List submitted print orders, newest first, with status, totals and dates. Filter by free text, production status, FinerWorks order ids, your own order POs (the order numbers from Shopify, Squarespace, etc.) or an order-date range. POST /v3/list_orders.

search.description: Text to search for in the order title or description.

order_ids.description: Optional list of FinerWorks order ids to filter by.

date_from.description: Orders placed on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

date_to.description: Orders placed on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: finerworks_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order in full: items, recipient, shipping method, status and totals. Needs the order GUID and the email address on the order. GET /v3/get_order.

order_email.description: The email address on the order (billing or recipient email).

tools.name: finerworks_get_order_status
tools.title: Get order production status
tools.description: The current production status of orders (in production, shipped, ...), looked up by your order PO numbers or FinerWorks order ids. An order that is not found returns nothing. POST /v3/fetch_order_status.

order_ids.description: FinerWorks order ids. Not needed when order_pos is given.

tools.name: finerworks_list_order_status_definitions
tools.title: List order status definitions
tools.description: All production statuses an order can have, with their ids. Use the id as the stable reference. GET /v3/list_order_status_definitions.

tools.name: finerworks_list_pending_orders
tools.title: List pending orders
tools.description: Orders saved but held in a pending status, not yet submitted for production (nothing is billed until submitted). POST /v3/list_pending_orders.

ids.description: Optional list of pending order ids to filter by.

skus.description: Only pending orders containing these SKUs.

tools.name: finerworks_list_virtual_inventory
tools.title: List virtual inventory
tools.description: The reusable print products (SKUs) saved in the account's virtual inventory: title, SKU, product code, image and price details. Filter by text, SKU, product code or product type. POST /v3/list_virtual_inventory.

search.description: Text to search for in the title or description.

product_type_ids.description: Optional list of product type ids to filter by.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: finerworks_get_product_details
tools.title: Get product details
tools.description: Details and pricing for up to 25 virtual inventory SKUs at given quantities. POST /v3/get_product_details.

sku.description: A virtual inventory SKU or a product code.

tools.name: finerworks_get_prices
tools.title: Get prices
tools.description: Price and price breakdown for up to 50 product codes or virtual inventory SKUs at given quantities. Nothing is ordered or billed. POST /v3/get_prices.

sku.description: A virtual inventory SKU or a product code.

products.description: Product codes or SKUs with quantities (up to 50).

tools.name: finerworks_list_product_types
tools.title: List product types
tools.description: The product types FinerWorks prints (fine art paper, canvas, wood, metal, cards, ...). POST /v3/list_product_types.

ids.description: Optional list of product type ids to filter by.

tools.name: finerworks_list_media_types
tools.title: List media types
tools.description: The papers and media FinerWorks prints on. POST /v3/list_media_types.

ids.description: Optional list of media ids to filter by.

tools.name: finerworks_list_style_types
tools.title: List style types
tools.description: The print styles FinerWorks offers (for example gallery wrap or float mount). POST /v3/list_style_types.

ids.description: Optional list of style ids to filter by.

tools.name: finerworks_list_static_products
tools.title: List static products
tools.description: Non-dynamic products, mostly accessories, that can be added to an order. POST /v3/list_static_products.

ids.description: Optional list of static product ids to filter by.

tools.name: finerworks_list_frame_collections
tools.title: List frame collections
tools.description: Frame collections (categories). Pass a collection id to list the frames in it; pass a product code to show only collections and frames compatible with that print product. POST /v3/list_collections.

id.description: Collection id. Required to list the frames inside a collection.

product_code.description: Only collections and frames compatible with this product code.

tools.name: finerworks_get_frame
tools.title: Get frame details
tools.description: Details of one frame by id (from finerworks_list_frame_collections). POST /v3/frame_details.

tools.name: finerworks_list_glazing
tools.title: List glazing
tools.description: The available glazing (glass and acrylic) options. POST /v3/list_glazing.

tools.name: finerworks_get_shipping_options
tools.title: Get shipping options
tools.description: Shipping options and rates for one prospective order: a recipient address plus the SKUs and quantities. Returns the shipping_code values an order would need. Nothing is ordered or billed. POST /v3/list_shipping_options_multiple.

state_code.description: US/Canada state or province code, e.g. AK.

province.description: Province or region for countries without state codes.

sku.description: A virtual inventory SKU or a product code.

tools.name: finerworks_validate_address
tools.title: Validate address
tools.description: Check a recipient address and return FinerWorks' corrected version. Nothing is saved or ordered. POST /v3/validate_recipient_address.

state_code.description: US/Canada state or province code, e.g. AK.

province.description: Province or region for countries without state codes.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with FinerWorks
prompts.description: What you can do with FinerWorks here, with example requests to try.
